description: Search the Book: every note the Observatory's desks have written since late September 2026, each a story read, checked and summarized from one or more sources, many of which never reached an issue. Returns the matching notes, best first: headline, summary, type, tags, desk, source, the original's address, the date, and the credibility label when the check gave one. Same query syntax as search_news.

desk.description: Only this desk: ai (the AI desk) or et (the Ethiopia desk).

query.description: What to look for, in English.

since.description: Only notes written from this date on (YYYY-MM-DD).
